evidence_quote: This study aimed to determine the coverage of the 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine (PPV23) and the influenza vaccine, along with related factors, among elderly individuals aged 60 y and above in the capital urban of China.
rationale: The study examines vaccine coverage, willingness, and uptake factors among elderly individuals. It does not address brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neurological disease, injury, or neurological treatments or biomarkers.
